verdict.rationale: Databricks explicitly documents a CLI and SDK designed for automation/CI use ("interact with the Databricks platform from your local terminal or automation scripts"), plus REST APIs and Databricks Connect for programmatic/headless workflows, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI installs and runs keylessly with jobs/pipelines automation support. missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/Jenkins integration guides) and independent community confirmation of headless CI usage.
